audience: field-service teams that dispatch technicians and bill customers with Auvo

useCases.title: Plan the technicians' workload for a date range
useCases.text: List the tasks of a date range and see which technician has how many. Filter by team or customer to check the load.

useCases.title: Review the open work for one customer
useCases.text: Find the customer, then list its tasks. Open one task to read its status and assigned technician.

useCases.title: Check the amounts customers still owe
useCases.text: List the open receivables and the invoices issued through Auvo. Ask which customers owe the most.

useCases.title: Create a task for a technician
useCases.text: Create a field-service task for a technician at a customer. Auvo notifies the assignee when the task is created.

useCases.title: Add a new customer from a lead
useCases.text: Create a customer record in Auvo. Each call creates a new record, so list the customers first.
